brief:
Fatah held commemorative events in Gaza on Tuesday to mark the Palestinian independence declaration anniversary, the Ma'an news agency reported. The movement organized rallies and public gatherings across the territory as part of annual observances honoring the November 1988 proclamation of Palestinian statehood.

The commemoration reflects Fatah's continued presence in Gaza despite the dominance of rival Hamas in the enclave's governance and security apparatus.
title: Fatah marks independence anniversary in Gaza
